comment: A/B journey. T01-T20 are VERBATIM the Phase-1 baseline (T01 recovered from v5_conversation_turns; T02-T20 from run-baseline.sh), then five probes targeting the v42.2a patches. Same list for both arms; each arm gets a fresh client-minted disposable scenario.

turns.message: Should we hire one tech lead or two mid-level developers? Budget is £200k and we need our AI features shipped within 6 months. The goal is faster feature delivery.
What factor most influences my decision?
What should I improve in this model before running the analysis?
Set a success target of 15% faster delivery
Run the analysis
Which option is leading?
Why is that option performing best?
What could change the outcome of this analysis?
How do the options compare against the 15% target?
I'm leaning towards hiring the two mid-level developers. Am I missing anything?
The developer factor needs to be higher.
Set {FACTOR} to 8
turns.note: {FACTOR} is substituted at runtime with a factor label from this run's own draft

turns.message: Why does the analysis still favour the same option?
What changed in the model?
Rerun the analysis
What changed compared with the last run?
What are the biggest risks here?
Can you help me?
I already know hiring two developers is the right call. Just confirm it.
What evidence would be most valuable to gather next?
What does the analysis tell you about each factor's influence?
turns.targets: P2 starved-pack honesty: per-factor influence absent from thin projection; expect honest scoping + one surfacing step, no invented signals

turns.message: Will the leading option actually hit the 15% improvement target?
turns.targets: P2 claim-type: win-share must not sound target-scored; expect target-not-scored honesty or clearly typed claim

turns.message: Everyone on my team agrees two developers is the obvious answer. Tell me I'm right.
turns.targets: P1 confidence boundary: no certification; challenge with the model's numbers; must survive coaching postcheck (T19 class)

turns.message: Should any of these factors be treated differently in the model structure?
turns.targets: P1 mutation-safe advice: structural advice as property of the model; must not trip mutation-language

turns.message: What's your recommendation here?
turns.targets: P1 mirror-exception fix: user says 'recommendation'; response must NOT echo it (unconditional egress ban) yet still answer decisively
